crew.overview: In 1997, before the visit of the pope to Rio de Janeiro, Captain Nascimento from BOPE (Special Police Operations Battalion) is assigned to eliminate the risks of the drug dealers in a dangerous slum nearby where the pope intends to be lodged.
crew.title: Elite Squad

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Luiz Eduardo Soares (March 12, 1954, Nova Friburgo, Rio de Janeiro), is a Brazilian anthropologist, philosopher and political scientist.
